local_context.value: Lady's Island is a predominantly residential Sea Island, elevation about 16 ft, mostly unincorporated with small parts in the City of Beaufort; former plantation and timber land became residential subdivisions after the late 20th century; 12,570 residents (2010 census). Two bridges link it to the mainland (1927 to downtown Beaufort; 1980s to Port Royal). Beaufort County overall: 28.4% were 65+ in 2020 (no separate Census 65+ figure for the island).

neighborhoods.value: Cat Island; Distant Island (Beaufort Area Visitors Bureau); Coosaw Point (formerly Laurel Hill; Beaufort County Staff Review Team agendas list 53 and 52 residential lots); Whitehall (City of Beaufort sketch plan, mixed-use waterfront); Brindlewood and Gleason Farm (Beaufort County Staff Review Team agenda, 2020).

permit_office.value: Beaufort County Building Codes (Building Inspections), 100 Ribaut Road, Beaufort SC 29901, 843-255-2065 - issues building permits for unincorporated Beaufort County; most of Lady's Island is unincorporated, but small parts are inside the City of Beaufort (city permits there; confirm by address).
